caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate, cylindrical vessel with a flared top and a circular base, rendered in graphite or pencil on a beige or light tan paper. The vessel features intricate decorative detailing along its rim and base, as well as a large central medallion on its body, which contains the image of a standing figure and the word “SPES.” Floral and foliate patterns are present on both sides of the medallion, enhancing the decorative aspect of the central area. In the top left corner of the drawing, there is an inset circular illustration labeled “FIDES,” showing a similar standing figure holding an object, possibly a book or similar item. In the top right corner, another inset circular illustration is labeled “CHARITAS,” showing yet another standing or walking figure, this one surrounded by smaller shapes that may represent children. Both of these medallion insets contain fine linework and are positioned in small squares. In the bottom right corner, a small inset technical diagram provides side and top dimensions of the vessel, showing a measured width and height. The artist's signature, “C. Sanborn,” is written near the lower right of the drawing. The overall composition is contained within a simple rectangular border. The entire piece is monochromatic, using shades of grey pencil against the neutral color of the paper.
title: Silver Communion Beakers
